title: Sharp mapping complexes of marked interval path pullbacks
statement:
Use quasicategories, spaces and coherent functor categories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and the marked cartesian simplicial model, internal Hom and sharp mapping complexes of [lem-coef-marked-point-cartesian-model]. Let $C,X,Y,Q$ be small quasicategories, let $f:X	o C$ and $g:Y	o C$ be arbitrary functors, and put $W=(C^
atural)^{(\Delta^1)^\sharp}$. Suppose $W	o C^
atural	imes C^
atural$ is a model fibration. Form the strict pullback of marked simplicial sets
$$H=(X^
atural	imes Y^
atural)	imes_{C^
atural	imes C^
atural}W.$$
Then $H$ is fibrant, so $H=R^
atural$ for its underlying quasicategory $R$. There is an isomorphism of Kan complexes
$$\operatorname{Map}^{\sharp}(Q^
atural,H)\cong\operatorname{Map}^{\sharp}(Q^
atural,X^
atural)	imes_{\operatorname{Map}^{\sharp}(Q^
atural,C^
atural),\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\operatorname{Map}^{\sharp}(Q^
atural,C^
atural))	imes_{\operatorname{ev}_1,\operatorname{Map}^{\sharp}(Q^
atural,C^
atural)}\operatorname{Map}^{\sharp}(Q^
atural,Y^
atural).$$
This isomorphism preserves the projections and the specified interval path. It is natural in $Q$ and in strictly commuting maps of the cospans, and remains valid on enlarging the input universe. In particular it identifies the displayed mapping complex with the path-space homotopy pullback of the other three mapping Kan complexes.
